story_overview.caption: Correct constituent answers coexist with failed composition in a Llama-3.1-8B example under one ten-paragraph context. The lower panel distinguishes a recoverable bridge address, paragraph access mass, and the local attention pattern through a schematic factorization of one head's evidence contribution.

data_fig3_diagnosis.caption: Native composition outcomes are conditioned on both constituent answers being correct. Bridge-address readers are evaluated on the resulting native composition failures. Training-source readers applied to native-model features compare full, attention-only, and paragraph-length/title metadata features.

data_fig4_causal.caption: The four-arm diagnostic crosses native or calibrated paragraph mass with receiver or direct-query local patterns on 100 receivers from 25 discovery quadruplets. Intervention calculations use receiver-computed values and unchanged output-projection weights. Earlier interventions can influence downstream activations. The separate 1,000-source control targets the bridge, root, or a length-matched other paragraph. Intervals resample quadruplets or sources for the corresponding paired comparisons.

data_fig5_content.caption: Edited-value following and joint original/edited correctness compare Native and CoReTrace on 100 reciprocal exchanges. The exchanges preserve full-input word and character multisets before evidence selection is rerun. Complete outcome exports also retain obsolete-answer persistence.

figure2_diagnosis.caption: Paired direct and composed queries localize heads with query-dependent bridge access. A four-arm diagnostic crosses paragraph mass and the normalized local attention pattern, using receiver-computed values and the original output-projection weights. Reciprocal object-surface exchanges assess the complete repair's response to local fact values. Colored head grids and attention bars illustrate the procedures.

data_app_localization.caption: Discovery mean differences in bridge-paragraph attention compare direct second-hop and composed questions over question-token rows. Selected heads are outlined. Layer summaries report mean and maximum measured head scores using zero-based layer and query-head indices.

data_app_necessity.caption: Completed-answer exact match on 1,000 test sources compares ranked-head and layer-matched random-head knockout for composed and both direct questions at doses 20, 40, and 80. Each random point uses one matched set. Zero denotes the native reference from this pipeline; selected head counts are 20, 20, and 40.

figure3_method.caption: Answer supervision adapts selected Q/K/V/O slices, fixed model-specific prefill rules restore native projection contributions, and training-source paragraph labels fit the address reader. Inference selects unique input-derived bridge candidates directly and uses a full-context readout pass for ambiguous candidates. The root and selected bridge paragraphs feed answer generation; inapplicable graphs retain the complete context. Exact restoration scopes are documented in the manuscript and recorded evaluation metadata.

data_app_ablation.caption: Fixed native-projection restoration is compared with head adaptation using the same trained slices. First-hop and all-three accuracy use 1,000 original-context test triplets with evidence selection disabled; GSM8K uses all 1,319 test questions. Labels report percentage-point changes and error bars summarize recorded-run sample standard deviation.

data_app_capabilities.caption: Native, full fine-tuning, and CoReTrace are compared on complete HotpotQA, MMLU, and GSM8K splits. Bars show benchmark-specific accuracy with recorded-run standard deviation. Full fine-tuning's zero GSM8K score accompanies zero valid final-answer lines under the stated metric.
